remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: Star. Back: 'Pastell – Waves – 21?'" [not verified]. Backing inscription, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1921. Dated 1922 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. See cat. nos. 381, 383–87. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
